offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Credit-based. Free: $0/month with 1,000 credits/month; Hobby: $16/month billed annually for 5,000 credits; Standard: $83/month billed annually for 100,000 credits; Growth: $333/month billed annually for 500,000 credits; Scale: $599/month billed annually for 1,000,000 credits. Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required; pricing page states this covers 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，包含标题、描述和 URL；可选返回网页 Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 支持 web、news、images；可按域名、地点、时间和类别筛选；搜索结果可选抓取内容。
